Methodology

Observed BingX VST closed one-minute candles only. Prehistory is warmup (not scored) and the scored window follows it; both are taken from the manifest. Every selected indication family calculates independently with all seven ranges, the balanced TP steps 2/3/5/8/12/18/24/30, SL ratios 0.6/1/1.4, three exits, long/short, and Normal/Axis/Block/DCA/Relate coordinations. Three independent engines run per symbol and indication: processed-set pyramid Block, processed-set rounds Block, and exec-branches gating with the small Exec window grid (Exec is reported only in this third engine). Tactic and Inverse use the declared default imported sources; Trend-Reversal uses all of its sources. Each engine warms up from prehistory and only then scores the window. Signals additionally require the configured three-percentage-point net-return drawdown limit in each gate window. Symbol admission uses available contracts and complete history only, never returns. The prehistory-selected summaries are a frozen subset selected from Base prehistory outcomes only (at least 20 closes and PF 1.1). Forward losses remain included. Enough-samples percentages divide created sets by their own required samples; zero sets means unavailable, not 0%. Model fills occur at observed closes and deduct verified-default taker fees plus fee-relative slippage once. Exchange minimum sizing, latency, funding and native protective fills are not simulated. Actual exchange PF is unavailable in this no-write simulation. Defaults are not promoted automatically.
